title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-13
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k)

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of a legendary Feb‑1970 Fillmore show highlighted by an iconic Dark Star, monster Smokestack and a sweet acoustic set.
ai_review.review: The recording (DP4) is a crystal‑clear soundboard source that most listeners describe as “pristine” with only a slight brightness that some tweak with bass/reverb. Musically the night shines – the second‑set Dark Star rolls into The Other One and Lovelight, while the acoustic set delivers a beautiful Uncle John’s Band and a monster Smokestack, all delivered by a tight band firing on all cylinders.

ai_rating.rationale: All ten reviews are five‑star, praising both the performance (standout jams, superb set flow) and the high‑fidelity soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: DP4 is praised as a pristine document; bright tonal balance noted but easily corrected with minor EQ. No dropouts or muffiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set opens the show with gentle harmonies, followed by an electric second set that builds into a marathon Dark Star > Other One > Lovelight sequence, delivering a seamless, high‑energy arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tone described as perfect; shares lead duties with Phil in The Other One.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass/lead playing lauded as practically on par with Jerry’s lead work.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir praised for being at his best during the acoustic set.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pig (Mickey) noted for “so much energy” that drives the band.
